text:
linh: quick sync — saw a perf regression on continuous-batching after yesterday's kernel selector change. want to finalize max-tokens-per-batch targets per card so the scheduler doesn't trigger fallback kernels.
raj: I pulled traces from the morning run. L4 kept falling back to the slow attention kernel when a 512-prefill request joined a 2048-decode batch. kv cache frag amplified it.
olivia: uploading perf flame and pprof in thread — but TL;DR: p50 decode increased ~18% on L4, p95 spiked when mixed prefill/decode mixes hit the same slice.
sam: are we sure it's kernel selection and not packing policy? I saw slot-ceiling cascades where a single big request consumes the slot budget and forces poor pack shapes.
raj: both. kernel-selector hysteresis made the runtime stick with a suboptimal kernel after a one-off long-seq request. combined with our default max_tokens_per_batch the scheduler created awkward tile shapes.
perf-bot: Alert: regression detected on channel eng-runtime — benchmark: cont-batch/gpt2-like on L4, p50 +17.9% vs baseline. see /ci/bench/1711504300.
linh: proposal time: set conservative per-GPU soft caps (targets, not hard ceil) and add faster decay in kernel-selector hysteresis for L4 and A10. suggested targets: A10: 20k tokens, T4: 4.5k, L4: 6k, A100: 24k, H100: 50k. these are tokens-per-batch totals (sum of request tokens in batch).
olivia: I prefer token budget expressed as per-slot because packing mix matters. e.g. T4 slot_target_tokens=1500, slots_per_gpu=3 -> ~4500 total. keeps slice shapes stable.
raj: adding this config fragment to try quickly:```yaml
continuous_batching:
  kernel_selector:
    hysteresis_half_life_seconds: 2   # faster recovery
  token_budget_targets:
    A10: "20000"
    T4: "4500"
    L4: "6000"
    A100: "24000"
    H100: "50000"
  per_slot_target_tokens:
    default: "1500"
    T4: "1500"
    L4: "2000"
```
sam: also add kv-cache frag guard: if kv_fragmentation_ratio > 0.25 then reduce batch_fanout and prefer same-request coalescing. That reduces kernel fallbacks due to scattered KV warmups.
linh: good call. olivia, can you run a short AB with these targets on the staging pool (L4 + A10 mixed) and capture kernel decisions + packing shapes? aim: 2k runs, 95% CI on p50.
olivia: starting now. I'll post quick traces and a summary in next 30m. expected plan: compare baseline->new-targets->new-targets+kv-guard.
raj: one more note — metrics to watch: kernel_switch_rate, avg_pack_utilization, kv_fragmentation_ratio, p50_decode, p95_decode, token_cost_per_thousand. if kernel_switch_rate > 0.02 we probably still need hysteresis tuning.
perf-bot: CI job queued: cont-batch-ab/1711504321-a/b (staging-l4-a10) — ETA ~28m.
linh: thanks. if AB looks good we'll roll soft caps to dedicated and add a canary for private deploys. :thumbsup:
olivia: quick note — I'll include a tiny profiler hook to log per-batch kernel_choice and pack_shape as a compact CSV to speed diffs.```
